domains.title: Cardiovascular
domains.meaning: Your heart and circulation readings are in line with your own pre-flight normal.
domains.rule: Domain status = the worst status of its metrics.

triggers.rule: AMBER if >= 2 SD worse than your baseline for >= 3 days in a row; RED if >= 3 SD for >= 3 days, or immediately if above 160 mmHg.
